headline: No Dogs in Space is back to feed your need for obsessive music history
summary: The music history podcast 'No Dogs in Space' has announced its return. Hosts Carolina Hidalgo and Marcus Parks are back for Season 4. The new season is titled 'Punk 2.0'.

headline: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang thinks AI fears are overblown.
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang believes fears about AI are unwarranted. He stated there's a "0% chance" of AI causing humanity's end. Huang's perspective comes despite warnings from many AI researchers.

headline: Kojima Productions disputes reports the studio is in trouble
summary: Kojima Productions is disputing reports of internal studio issues. Rumors surfaced after Sony dropped Hideo Kojima's 'Physint'. Bloomberg had cited missed deadlines and budget concerns.

headline: Trump now says he wants to form an ‘AI Force’
summary: Donald Trump announced his plan to create an 'AI Force' via Truth Social. He intends to appoint an 'AI czar' to lead this new initiative. Trump stated his administration would not hinder AI development.

headline: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story Review
summary: The review critiques 'Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story'. It aimed to explore themes of female rage. The film is criticized for failing to commit to its message.

headline: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Will 'Easily Take Over 100 Hours' for Completionists to Beat, Director Teases
summary: Director Naoki Hamaguchi hinted at 'Final Fantasy 7 Revelation' playtime. Completionists could spend over 100 hours in the game. This refers to the final part of the remake trilogy.

headline: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil Defies Expectations With $108 Million Box Office Opening Weekend
summary: Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' achieved a strong box office opening. The film garnered an estimated $108.3 million globally. This success comes despite initial backlash.

headline: Disney+ to Allow Ads on All Plans Following Changes Detailed in Updated Subscriber Agreement
summary: Disney+ has updated its subscriber agreement. The change clarifies that ads will now be allowed on all subscription tiers. This means even premium plans may feature advertisements.

headline: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
summary: German Chancellor Merz labeled the state election results a "disaster". Exit polls showed significant losses for his CDU party. Despite the setbacks, Merz has pledged to remain in his position.

headline: Key takeaways from BBC interview as Earl Spencer defends claims about King
summary: Earl Spencer was interviewed by the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg. He used the platform to defend claims made about the King. The interview took place ahead of his new book about Princess Diana.

headline: Specialist courts for rape cases to be rolled out across England and Wales
summary: Specialist courts for rape cases are set to be launched. Funding will enable victims to view proceedings remotely. They can also give evidence from a separate room via video link.

headline: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns
summary: The National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT) demands a stop to graded Ofsted inspections. They cite serious health concerns for school leaders. The union claims inspections pose a "risk to life".
